newsitem.title: USA: Green Oasis South Carolina plant cleared.
newsitem.headline: Green Oasis South Carolina plant cleared.

text.p: Green Oasis Environmental Inc said Friday it has resolved all outstanding issues related to the start-up, initial testing and the ultimate permitting of its Charleston waste oil processing facility with the South Carolina Department of Health and Environmental Control.

The resulting consent order enables Green Oasis to bring its unit on line as soon as possible so as to demonstrate both its technological process as well as its ability to comply with environmental standards, the company said.

"This not only clears for the re-start of our Charleston waste oil processing facility, but it will also enable our pending customers to complete tue diligence by viewing the technology in the continuous operational basis required in order to firm up their orders by making the necessary down payments, the company said.
It said this also will initially enable the creation of 30 new jobs to manufacture the nine units the company intends to deliver in 1997. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
